lessons.title: Future Plans

items.example: Eu vou viajar no próximo mês.

items.exampleMeaning: Do you want to go to the cinema?

items.example: Eu quero convidar você para a festa.
items.exampleMeaning: I want to invite you to the party.

items.example: Qual é a data da reunião?
items.exampleMeaning: What is the date of the meeting?

items.example: Está certo, vamos nos encontrar às cinco.
items.exampleMeaning: That's right, let's meet at five.

lessons.tip: In Brazilian Portuguese, the future is often expressed using 'vou' plus the verb. For example, 'Vou viajar' means 'I will travel.'

scenario.brief: You want to make plans for Saturday. Ask about the date and time.
scenario.goal: You will successfully arrange to meet on Saturday.

lessons.title: Invitations

items.example: Eu tenho um convite para a festa.
items.exampleMeaning: I have an invitation to the party.
Shall we go together to the cinema?

items.example: O que você acha da festa?
items.exampleMeaning: What do you think of the party?
Would you like to go with me?

lessons.tip: When inviting someone, you can use 'você gostaria de ir?' to ask if they want to join. It's polite and friendly.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Eu tenho um convite para a festa.
dialogue.meaning: I have an invitation to the party.

scenario.partnerRole: A friend inviting you to a party.
scenario.brief: Discuss weekend plans and invitations with your friend.
scenario.goal: You will agree to go to the party together.

lessons.title: Confirming Plans

items.example: Vamos falar mais tarde sobre isso.
Qual é o seu plano para o fim de semana?
items.exampleMeaning: What is your plan for the weekend?

lessons.tip: When confirming plans, use 'Você pode confirmar?' to ask for confirmation. It's clear and straightforward.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sim, está tudo certo para amanhã.
dialogue.meaning: Yes, everything is okay for tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Qual é o seu plano para o fim de semana?
dialogue.meaning: What is your plan for the weekend?

scenario.brief: Confirm your plans for the weekend with your friend.
scenario.goal: You will confirm the details for your plans.

lessons.title: Discussing Dates

items.exampleMeaning: The day after tomorrow is Friday.

items.example: Na próxima semana é a reunião.

items.exampleMeaning: Let's see if we can go.

lessons.tip: When discussing dates, you can ask 'Qual dia é?' to find out the specific day. It's a useful question to know.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.meaning: The day after tomorrow is Sunday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Na próxima semana, vamos nos encontrar?

scenario.partnerRole: A friend discussing plans for the week.
scenario.brief: Ask about the dates and confirm your plans for the coming days.
scenario.goal: You will clarify the dates for your plans.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Qual é a data da reunião?
dialogue.meaning: What is the date of the meeting?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.meaning: Shall we go together to the cinema?

scenario.partnerRole: A friend discussing plans for the weekend.
scenario.brief: Discuss your weekend plans and confirm details with your friend.
scenario.goal: You will successfully confirm your plans for the weekend.
